title: If someone does something to you, do it right back.
paragraphs: “Y-youuuuuuuuuuuuuu!”
“But… do I really have time to be mad at Gaelion?”
As Rival gave the signal, the pig—now transformed into a monster—turned toward Takt and began to attack him.
“Hey! Everyone! Pull yourselves together! Hey!”
“Woof woof! Growl! Gaaaaaaah!”
“Ow! Stop it! Hey! Cut it out already! Hey!”

At first, Takt tried to reason with the monsters as they lunged at him, but he must have quickly shown his true colors, because he’s now fighting back with his sword. He’s making a token effort to aim for their legs and such, trying to disable them.

“Takt, it seems you tried to win by taking the Filolial egg hostage from the Spear Hero, but now it’s your turn. Gaelion holds the lives of your women in his hands. Make one wrong move, and the women around you will die.”
“Y-youuuuuu!”

“……As the King of Monsters, Gaelion will use any means necessary to slaughter these vile beings who desecrate the Filolial. Takt, this is what you’ve done. Straight from Wild Naofumi himself: ‘If you get hit, hit back’…!”
“Huh!? Me!?”
At this point, Father will speak up, saying he’s taken aback.
“Na-nooon”
Don’t be shy, Rival!
“The ‘other me’ that Motoyasu-kun talks about…”

He’s lamenting, but honestly, this is exactly the kind of attack Father would order Rival to carry out with a smile… No, wait—I’m sure he’d deny it, of course. As Rival floats a soft, magical light, the wound inflicted on Takt by the monster pig begins to heal. The monster pig, its wound now healed, lunged at Takt once more.
“I’ll heal a wound this minor so you can keep fighting. Come on, go! Gaelion’s minions!”
As it said this, the monster pig attacked another pig, and Rival used Magic to subdue it.
“Come on, Takt, go kill some other women. Otherwise, this one’s gonna die, too. Yeah, yeah!”
“H-huh? Don’t mess with meeeeeeeeeee!”

Takt roars. Am I messing around? You’re the one who did this to Filolial-sama. Rival… It’s frustrating, but just this once, I’ll give you credit for your tactics. Though I’ll definitely never say that out loud.
“Well then… I’ll spread the rumor that your women were transformed into monstrous beasts by your power and have been wreaking havoc across the world.”
“Boo-boo!”
“Bbuuuu!”
“Ugh… Fine. Everyone, I’m sorry, but this is for the sake of the others. I won’t hold back! Haaaaah!”
After hearing the pigs’ lines, Takt began slicing down the monster pigs that were attacking him.
“Gaa—Oink—Bub—”
Only that last line sounded like a pig, didn’t it? Takt’s face is contorted more than I’ve ever seen before.
Hahaha, serves you right, Takt. Let’s make you suffer some more.

But… what kind of guy is he? His mindset shifts incredibly fast. I couldn’t even move when they took Filolial-sama’s egg hostage, but Takt cut them down with ease. Could it be he actually liked those pigs?!

“Oh my… he’s cutting them down way too easily. Even though I left his subconscious intact, even though he was a monster on the surface. To kill him without even trying to find a way to save him… Do you care that much about your own life? Well, she’s just a trophy wife after all.”
Saying that, Rival fixed Takt with an even more contemptuous gaze.

“It would’ve been better if you’d just been as useless as the Spear Hero. A true hero would’ve put up a bit more of a fight… Well then, Takt, I’m going to have to make you suffer a little longer… You’re going to be so pitiful later on. Because of you, your woman’s soul will be devoured by Gaelion.”
With that, Rival gathered the soul of the monster pig that Takt had finished off and sucked it into her hand.
“You bastard…!”
Takt, having witnessed this, felt his murderous intent grow even stronger.
“Hmph. Takt, don’t think that just killing those things has solved the problem. Remember… what you lot have done.”
At Rival’s words, Takt snaps back to his senses and looks at the pig he’d killed.
“Grr… Uuuu…”

Then… the dead monster pig swayed to its feet as a “Fresh Beast Zombie” and lunged at Takt. The former representative pig of Shieldfreeden did the same, rising to its feet as well. Ah, as if to deliver the final blow, Rival placed his hand on the former Shieldfreeden pig, extracted the Dragon Emperor’s Core Stone, and absorbed it.
“This realm has already become Gaelion’s. Come on, dance some more!”
“Ooogggghhhhhh!?”
The pigs started screaming. Oh my, a pig in a monk’s robe is praying to purify them, but it seems utterly powerless against Rival’s Magical Power.
“Ooogggghhhhhh————Ooooh… Uuuu…”
They were then attacked by the Fresh Beast Zombies and turned into Fresh Zombies themselves.
“Ooogggghhhh!? Ooogggghhhh!”
Seeing this, the rest of the pigs began to flee in panic. On the flip side, isn’t this actually an opportunity?
“This is terrible… I guess they’re supposed to be our allies, but what do you think of that as a knight?”
“I have no sympathy for them.”
“Well, they did what they did, after all.”
“I do think they should have handled it more gracefully.”
Yuki-chan said this to the panda, the Éclair, and the elephant. Those methods are brutal!
“You vile wretch! You’re the true Demon King!”

“It’s quite amusing for you to call what you yourself did ‘the work of a Demon King.’ But you’re absolutely right… depending on the era and location, the Dragon Emperor is also called the Demon King. With Gaelion’s current knowledge, he can even wield the power of the Otherworld. That’s right, that’s right, that’s right!”
With the air of a true champion, Rival smiled at Takt.
“I’ll never forgive you! I’ll kill you before that ‘Spear Hero Who Can’t Fight’ even gets a chance!”
“Go ahead and try if you think you can. Gaelion, since you’re the Demon King now, face me with courage. If by some chance you show courage, I might even recognize you as a hero.”
Rival turns his gaze to Yuki-chan, Éclair, Panda, and the others, signaling for them not to intervene. Éclair and the others nodded, seemingly understanding Rival’s intentions.
“Regardless of your methods, this time I’ll step aside out of respect for your feelings,”
Yuki-chan says, seeming to accept this as well.
“Everyone! Don’t panic! Let’s go!”

Takt, having received support magic from the pig crew, swings his weapon at Rival. Just like the Pandas did, Rival dodges Takt’s fierce attack by the skin of his teeth. His movements are actually a bit faster than the Pandas’ were.
“Don’t think you can dodge it like you did before! Starkfaafar!”
Ah, that’s the attack Takt unleashed on me in the previous run. Since he can dodge it, he’s relying on Skills this time…

“No matter what kind of attack it is… I have absolutely no intention of losing to someone like you!　For the sake of the people of this world, I won’t back down! After this, Gaelion has to face the Spear Hero!”
Right after Rival declared that, Father-in-law’s shield glowed brightly, and a beam of light shot toward Rival’s hand. W-wait, I’ve seen this before.
“Really? Well, no matter what, I can’t judge him based on something like this. Ah… so the Claw Spirit is furious too? I get it. Let’s get back at Takt together.”

And there… lo and behold, the Seven Star Weapons—which were supposed to be Filo-tan’s weapons—were now in Rival’s hand! Could it be that the Claw Spirit has actually hit it off with Rival!? Of course, Rival used his claws to slash through whatever was about to burst forth from the ground—that mysterious Skill Takt had unleashed.
“What! For that to appear right here is a golden opportunity! Hand it over!”
“That’s not gonna happen, you know.”
In a flash, Rival tore off pieces of his own scales and blood and infused them into the Seven Star Weapons of the Claw, forcibly altering its shape to enhance it.
“E-enhancing it in the middle of battle…”
Grrr… That rival of mine. He’s really something!
“Here, take this. This is… the blow you brought upon yourself!”
The claws in Rival’s hand change shape—it’s that skill I’ve seen so many times, even though Filo-tan never used it—and he unleashes it at Takt.
“Varnz Claw!”
A straight-line attack shot from Rival’s hand and pierced right through Takt.
Takt, having been pierced, staggered a few steps before placing a hand over his pierced chest to regain his composure.
“Hah! Too bad for you. An attack like this is meaningless against me now that I’ve got a new body!”
Even as he says this, he’s coughing up blood. It seems the healing delay effect is taking its toll.
“Yeah… My claws wanted to strike back, but the cost is too high.”
After unleashing those skills, Rival is feeling dizzy. I’d love to make him suffer for the cost, but for now… I’ll hold back.
“That’s how you are, isn’t it! But I’m not the type to—”
“Spiral Claw X”
“Oink—!?”
As if testing it out, Rival fired the same spiral-shaped thrust skill that Filo-tan had used—this time aimed at the pig behind Takt’s right shoulder—and the pig was turned into mincemeat.
You, Rival! You just blew away all of Filolial-sama’s eggs that were wrapped around that pig! I’ll never forget this!
“Wha…”

“What are you so satisfied with, using Skills like that? Are you an idiot? Seven Star Weapons… are used like this. This is the difference in power between an illegitimate possessor like you and one with proper knowledge. Got it? Monkey Mountain Boss. This toy is way too good for scum like you.”

Rival is provoking Takt to the absolute limit. That attitude reminds me of Father. It’s certainly no exaggeration to say he learned it directly from Father in the first world. I even imitate him sometimes myself.
“To begin with, Takt, haven’t you heard the story from the Wise King of Wisdom about the Spear Hero looping?”
“W-well… there’s no way a guy who’s pulling off such a sloppy mess would have a cheat like looping!”
“What did you say!?”
It’s a fact that I’m looping!

“Ah, Takt, knowing you, you probably thought something like, ‘There’s no way someone with a looping ability could have a cheat ability even more powerful than mine! After all, the rest of them were all total pushovers!’ and that’s why you didn’t believe it, isn’t it?”
“W-what, who do you think you are, reading me like that! Don’t just go making assumptions!”
Takt’s stuttering. I hit the nail on the head, didn’t I!
“No matter what you say, it’s a fact. The reason you got slaughtered by the Spear Hero was because you were looping. Besides, did you really think I didn’t know your background? Reincarnator.”
“W-what…”
Takt is looking back and forth between Rival and me. Looks like he’s finally figured it out.
“H-hell no! That’s… that woman! Are you saying she bestowed it on a guy like this, too?”
“That’s off the mark. The one behind you… has already been taken care of. There’s no hope for him. Well, I won’t deny that the Spear Hero is a total klutz.”
“Rival! If you let him keep talking, he’ll get way too bold! Don’t get too cocky!”
While all this was going on, the Queen’s wounds—which Father and I had been treating with all our might—finally closed, just barely.
“Cough… cough…”
“Her condition has finally stabilized.”
“Ah, thank you. Mr. Iwatani, Mr. Kitamura, I’m so sorry to have troubled you at a time when the decisive battle is upon us…”
The Queen is thanking us. Then she turns her gaze toward Trash. Trash looked relieved that the Queen had somehow pulled through, then turned his gaze toward us.
He’s angry, and he’s filled with murderous intent. Yet his expression remains calm and composed.
“I harbor a grudge against you lot that’s deep enough to rot. You’re still the ones responsible for Malty’s death. But… for saving Mirellia and Melty… I have no choice but to thank you.”
“Father…”
Her finacée, protected by Sakura-chan, speaks to Trash.

“Since Mother is having trouble speaking, I’ll say it again. Please… could you not set aside your grudge against the Spear Heroes and Shield Heroes? The fault lies with us. What happened to my older sister was her own doing… it would be unfair to hold a grudge against them.”
“…Hmph!”
The Trash said nothing more than that. While cradling the queen protectively, he glanced at me and Father, then glared at Takt.

“…What are you doing? Go and slaughter that enemy already. I’ll put an end to you lot eventually, but I won’t fight you now. You want to end this quickly before any more damage is done, don’t you? If you’re serious, these guys aren’t even a match for you.”
“…Did you know?”

“Of course. Despite my orders to train harder and wait for the right opportunity, you launched a foolish operation behind my back and, while claiming to have rescued Mirellia and the others, took them hostage instead. I thought you were comrades who shared the same pain, but if you’ve even laid a hand on Mirellia, that’s a different story. I have no obligation to help you.”

I see. So Trash had accurately assessed our true strength after all, but Takt, convinced he could win, acted on his own and committed such a reckless act that it drove Trash to betray us. Furthermore, Trash shook his head repeatedly in sorrow upon seeing the Queen, her Finacée, and the Tiger siblings. It seems he hasn’t been able to come to terms with his emotions yet.
“I understand… but let me ask you just one thing.”
“If you could foresee all this, you must have known Takt would lose. So why are you here?”
“…It was a hunch. I sensed that misfortune would befall Mirellia and Melty at the hands of Takt and his crew. And Big Sister’s… no, never mind! In the end, you guys saved me, after all.”
“So you chose your family over revenge? Father… no, Aultcray, we’ll settle this someday. But for now, we’re leaving. Motoyasu… you’re not ready to fight yet, are you?”
“…No, I’m coming too.”

I shook my head at Father’s question. I’m extremely unhappy about this and would rather not do it, but to prevent the worst-case scenario that Rival mentioned from coming true, I’ll stay here… and swallow this bitter pill for the sake of the future Filolial-sama. We stood up and hurried over to where Rival was. Takt clicked his tongue at our arrival, flashing a scheming smile.
“What’s this? Finally got your whole gang together, huh?”
He’s slowly, bit by bit, trying to put some distance between himself and us.
“Hey, Spear… You can’t possibly not know what this is, can you?”
Takt had the pig toss another of Filolial-sama’s eggs to him, and he flaunted it in my face.
“Hurry up and slaughter every last one of them. Otherwise… if I don’t report my victory, my comrades will smash the eggs they’ve secured!”
“…I can’t possibly listen to a piece of trash like you.”
“What did you say?! This isn’t a threat!”
With a loud crash, Takt smashed Filolial-sama’s egg right there on the ground. I’ll make sure to torture you horribly before killing you! If you think you’ll die easily, you’re sorely mistaken!
“Well then… Takt. That’s it for your punching bag session—the one meant to vent the pent-up frustration of the Gaelions who suffered because of your mess.”
“What!? A punching bag!?”
Takt’s eyebrows shot up even higher.

“I’m telling you this out of pity… The methods for strengthening a hero’s weapons can be shared. Your method—where you’re so full of yourself that you think you can unlock a weapon’s true power by stealing it—is something that comes standard. Or did you actually think that applying enhancement methods to Skills and Magic was just a bluff?”
“Wh—”
It’s easy to imagine that no matter how much I listen to Takt, he’ll ultimately act to wipe out Filolial-sama. So… no matter what, I won’t obey him! And… this is what I’m going to do!
I’ve posted a new chapter. Please support me and the warriors of this other world.
